meta.title: "Convert to Auction" is disabled on an old version, a project on hold, or a closed trade-mode event
gaps: Open an older version of an RFQ with two versions; the prepared state supplies no older version.
Inspect a project on hold; the prepared event is live and no catalog step can place it on hold.

Assert Convert to Auction is present but disabled in all three required contexts.
